title: Rabbi Yehudah ben Yair, a Tanna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yevamot 80b mentions Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel reporting in his name. Some propose that he was Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair’s brother, but Hyman finds this very difficult: Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair was a colleague of Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi, so how could Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel report his brother?

notes.text: Hyman finds the proposed brotherhood chronologically very difficult; this is an argument against it, not a finding that it is impossible.
